wallpapers.title: COSMIC CLIFFS
wallpapers.line1: Edge of a star nursery in the Carina Nebula, 7,600 light-years away. This light left it 7,600 years ago.
wallpapers.line2: James Webb Space Telescope  ·  12 July 2022  ·  NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI

wallpapers.title: WEBB'S FIRST DEEP FIELD
wallpapers.line1: Thousands of galaxies in a patch of sky the size of a grain of sand held at arm's length.
wallpapers.line2: Galaxy cluster SMACS 0723, seen as it was 4.6 billion years ago  ·  Webb  ·  12 July 2022  ·  NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI

wallpapers.title: THE DAY THE EARTH SMILED
wallpapers.line1: Saturn hides the Sun, so its rings glow. Earth is the pale blue dot below the rings, marked.
wallpapers.line2: Cassini, 1.2 million km from Saturn  ·  19 July 2013  ·  NASA/JPL-Caltech/SSI

wallpapers.title: MOONRISE FROM ORBIT
wallpapers.line1: A waxing gibbous Moon rises above Earth's thin blue air, over a cloudy Atlantic off the coast of Quebec.
wallpapers.line2: International Space Station, Expedition 73, 423 km up  ·  3 October 2025  ·  NASA

wallpapers.title: HERBIG-HARO 46/47
wallpapers.line1: Two newborn stars, only a few thousand years old, blowing jets of gas. 1,470 light-years away.
wallpapers.line2: James Webb Space Telescope  ·  26 July 2023  ·  NASA, ESA, CSA, J. DePasquale (STScI)

wallpapers.title: TARANTULA NEBULA
wallpapers.line1: Tens of thousands of young stars, 161,000 light-years away in the Large Magellanic Cloud.
wallpapers.line2: James Webb Space Telescope  ·  6 September 2022  ·  NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI

wallpapers.title: HORSEHEAD NEBULA
wallpapers.line1: Part of the Horsehead (Barnard 33), rising from waves of dust and gas in Orion. 1,300 light-years away.
wallpapers.line2: James Webb Space Telescope  ·  29 April 2024  ·  ESA/Webb, NASA, CSA, K. Misselt (U. Arizona), A. Abergel (IAS/Paris-Saclay, CNRS)

wallpapers.title: IC 2163 AND NGC 2207
